[b]How to Install: [/b]
[list=1]
[*]Go to your Stardew Valley installation folder.
[*]Back up your Stardew Valley\Contents\Characters\Evelyn.xnb and Stadew Valley\Contents\Portraits\Evelyn.xnb 
[*]Extract the contents of the .zip file into the Stardew Valley\Contents folder.
[*]Allow the files to overwrite.

[/list]
[b]NO OVERWRITE Install:[/b][i] [/i](Requires [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI[/url], [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/resources/entoarox-framework.4228/]Entoarox Framework[/url], and [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/resources/xnb-loader.4506/]Xnb Loader[/url])
[list=1]
[*]Go to your Stardew Valley installation folder.
[*]Extract the contents of the .zip file into the Stardew Valley\Mods\XnbLoader\ModContent folder.

[/list]
